steps.what: Pull history for the cost estimates.
Calculate the forecasts from that history.
Adjust the cost models for a missing constraint.
Check the forecasts before they are filed.
File the forecasts on the planning record.

tasks.design: {BI} calculates forecasts from {ERP} history. The analyst adjusts the cost models when a constraint is missing, then {ERP} files the checked forecasts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Forecasts were retyped from a private workbook each quarter.
tasks.enabler_now: History and the arithmetic can live in one view.
tasks.still_hard: A model that has not seen a new lane will look precise and be wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which constraint the history does not contain.

ambition.what: Refresh a forecast when a lane opens, not only at quarter end.

tasks.altitude: Adjusting the model stays. The calculation and the filing do not.

reach.task: Use the filed forecast in the budget
reach.learn: Which constraints were adjusted by hand

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from cost history to a filed forecast. Setting the budget is finance's task.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are lane id, period, cost and volume. The history produces them. Fallback: a period with no volume is not forecast.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which cost history is complete enough to forecast.
research_questions: How often an adjustment reverses the calculated figure.

already_counted.description: Adjusting models the history cannot see

incremental.description: Keep cost categories aligned with the ledger

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Complete history saves the calculation and the filing. The adjustment stays. The low case is a new lane with no history.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather maintenance events the report must include.
Draft documentation for the automated logistics report.

loop.purpose: Draft the report from maintenance events.
loop.check: Every figure cites an event id.
loop.stop: Stop after one draft or when a figure has no event.
loop.why_not_simpler: A standing template cannot see this period's events.

steps.what: Validate the documentation against the source events.
Publish the validated report to the record.

tasks.design: Maintenance events feed one draft in {DOCS}. The analyst validates every figure against an event. The record receives only that validated report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were pasted together, and a figure could not be traced to an event.
tasks.enabler_now: Events already have ids a draft can cite.
tasks.still_hard: A cited event can still be the wrong event for the sentence.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can see when the draft has described a different failure.
tasks.altitude: Validation stays. Assembling the standard sentences does not.

reach.task: Correct an event the report has misread
reach.learn: Which event ids the report cites

evidence.claim: A generated report still needs a person to check each figure against a source event.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from maintenance events to a validated report. Fixing the equipment is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are event id, asset id, time and status. The event log produces them. Fallback: a sentence with no event id is removed, not left in.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which event logs are complete for the period.
research_questions: How often validation removes a figure the draft included.

incremental.description: Keep event-type names aligned with the log

approvals.approved_version: report the analyst validated against events

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A complete event log saves the draft and the publish. Validation stays. The low case is a period whose events have no ids.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read distribution and transportation volumes.
Compute capacity against that volume.
Walk the facility the plan would change.
Judge which logistical capacity analyses hold.
Check the planning note after the walk.
File the planning note on the project.

tasks.design: {BI} computes capacity from {ERP} volumes. The analyst walks the facility and keeps only the analyses the walk supports. {PROJECT} receives the note after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Capacity was a spreadsheet that nobody had checked against the building.
tasks.enabler_now: Volumes and stated limits can be compared before the walk.
tasks.still_hard: A limit on a drawing can be wrong once you stand in the aisle.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can reject a surplus the building cannot use.
tasks.altitude: The walk and the judgement stay. The capacity sum does not.

reach.task: Change a lane the capacity note has constrained
reach.learn: Which limit came from the walk and which from the volume

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from volumes and a walk to a filed planning note. Buying space is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are facility id, volume, stated limit and a note from the walk. Fallback: a limit not seen on the walk is marked unverified.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which facilities can be walked in the planning week.
research_questions: How often the walk changes the computed surplus.

already_counted.description: Judging the analyses after the walk

incremental.description: Keep stated limits aligned with the buildings in use

approvals.approved_version: planning note checked after the walk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Known volumes save the sum and the filing. The walk and the judgement stay. The low case is a building that was not walked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge whether a facility change is feasible.

steps.what: Read space, location and cost factors.
Walk the existing facilities under review.
Sketch options for modifying those facilities.
Test the cost of each sketched option.
Judge the feasibility of designing the new option.
Check the feasibility note after the walk.
Issue the feasibility note to the project.

tasks.design: Space, location and cost factors are read first. The analyst walks the existing facilities. {BI} sketches options and tests cost. The note is issued only after the walk is in the judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasibility was a cost sheet prepared before anyone visited.
tasks.enabler_now: Cost tests can be run once the factors are fields.
tasks.still_hard: A cheap option can be impossible on the ground.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst has stood in the space the sheet treats as free.
tasks.altitude: The walk and the feasibility judgement stay. The cost test does not.

reach.task: Design only an option the note has called feasible
reach.learn: Which factors were verified on the walk

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from factors and a walk to an issued feasibility note. The design itself is a later task. Approval is the post-walk note, not the cost test.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are facility id, space, location class and cost factor. Fallback: space seen only on the walk is typed and marked unverified.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Whether existing facilities may be walked before the note is due.
research_questions: How often the walk kills the cheapest option.

incremental.description: Keep location classes and cost factors current

approvals.approved_version: feasibility note checked after the walk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Known factors save the sketch and the cost test. The walk and the judgement stay. The low case is a facility that was not walked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Site walks, contract judgement and what is promised to a customer stay with the analyst. Volume sums and document drafts do not.
reach: Contract owners, on which commitment fields a gap list needs.
Facilities engineers, on which site facts a layout needs.
skills_to_grow: Refusing a saving that the site cannot run.
role.ambitious_version: A proposal to a customer names the constraint, the option and the person who may commit.
